summary: Processes an array of element descriptors with a scaled-size calculation and modulo-based data positioning, then performs a bounded data fill into a double-buffered element buffer. Element count guard gates the whole loop. Called by AudioStreamBufferFill (00519720).

local_names.result: element descriptor array pointer / final loop counter

operations.description: Initialize element loop counter v9 to 0.
Load descriptor array pointer a1[49] (this+0xC4) into result and element data buffer pointer a1[96] (this+0x180) into v2.
Element count guard: enter the processing loop only when a1[8] (this+0x20) is greater than 0; otherwise return 0.
Iterate elements while v9 is less than a1[8] (this+0x20); the descriptor iterator v3 advances by 21 dwords (84 bytes) per element.
Compute per-element scaled size v6 = descriptor[0] * descriptor[6] / a1[69] (this+0x114 divisor).
Compute modulo-wrapped data size v8 = descriptor[8] % (descriptor[0]*descriptor[6]); when the remainder is zero, v8 is replaced by the full product.
On the first element (v9 == 0), write the computed output row size (v8-1)/v6+1 into buffer descriptor field v2+72 (this+0x1C8).
Perform the data fill only when 2*v6 is greater than 0.
Fill 2*v6 dwords at target pointer v4 with the dword at v4-4. Target v4 is derived from the double-buffer selector field v2+64 (this+0x1C0), the element index v9, and the wrapped size 4*v8.
Return the final element loop counter value, or 0 when the count guard blocks. __usercall ABI: this pointer in ESI, result in EAX. This function is invoked by AudioStreamBufferFill.
